metadata.pr_description:
This PR updates benchmark README for the latest change from https://github.com/vllm-project/vllm/pull/15955 . Also, it adds AIMODataset to `benchmark_throughput.py` 

@JenZhao @ywang96 Thank you for the comments!

review_planner.summary: The changes introduce a new dataset `AIMODataset` and update the README and benchmark scripts to support it.

tasks.title: Security Review
tasks.description: Verify that the introduction of `AIMODataset` does not introduce any security vulnerabilities, especially related to data handling and command execution.

tasks.title: Logic Review
tasks.description: Verify that the logic for handling `AIMODataset` is correct and that all paths through the code are properly covered, especially in `get_requests` and `validate_args` functions.

tasks.title: Performance Review
tasks.description: Check if the addition of `AIMODataset` could have any performance implications, particularly in terms of loading and processing the dataset.

tasks.title: General Review
tasks.description: Ensure that the README updates accurately reflect the new dataset and provide clear instructions for running benchmarks with `AI-MO/aimo-validation-aime`.
